text:
maria: Heads-up — we've got multiple customers hitting weird client behavior because our API and Dedicated return different status/code shapes. Example from support: a 200 with {"error":{"code":"quota_exceeded","message":"quota"}} vs a 429 with the same message. Client SDKs treat them differently.

aj: Ugh. That explains the retry loops. Which endpoints specifically?

maria: Mostly /v1/generate and some streaming cases where we send a trailing error event but the connection stays 200 — SDK sees partial success and doesn't bubble as an error.

devon: Can you paste the exact bodies? We should standardize both status + machine error code.

maria: Sure. From hosted: 200; body: `{"id":"resp_abc", "error":{"code":"rate_limit_exceeded", "message":"Quota reached"}}`

From Dedicated: 429; body: `{"error":{"code":"rate_limit_exceeded", "message":"Exceeded tokens"}}`

sasha: That's dangerous. SDKs usually look at status first, then body. If status=200 they assume success. We need a canonical mapping: status should reflect severity, but keep machine `error.code` stable for programmatic handling.

aj: Proposed mapping: client-visible set — 400 (bad_request), 401 (unauth), 403 (forbidden), 404 (not_found), 409 (conflict), 429 (rate_limit/quota), 503 (unavailable/backoff), 500 (internal). For streaming, emit an error control-frame with an aligned status+code.

devon: Agree on codes. Also propose we add `error.retryable` boolean and `error.suggested_retry_after` (seconds) fields so SDKs can auto-handle backoff. Example: `{"error":{"code":"rate_limit_exceeded", "message":"Quota reached", "retryable":true, "retry_after":30}}`

maria: That would be great. From UX/console side, product wants consistent copy in Console's per-route dashboards and in the public API docs. We should centralize the human-friendly message generation so wording is identical across web UI and error responses.

sasha: Ops note — some infra layers currently swallow upstream status and rewrite to 200 with an error blob for agents that can't process non-200. That's our root cause. We should stop that and instead return the original status + canonical body. Breaking change risk for some legacy clients though.

aj: For rollout: 1) start emitting new fields (`error.code`, `error.retryable`, `error.retry_after`) under a feature flag on staging; 2) update SDKs to prefer status but fallback to `error.code` if status=200; 3) flip infra so edge proxies preserve status; 4) update Console and docs copy.

devon: I'll open PRs: runtime change + infra change. Need decision on timeline.

maria: Customer impact high, let's aim for canary on staging this week, gradual rollout on Dedicated next week, hosted follows after SDK bump.

sasha: Also add telemetry: expose a dashboard tile showing mismatched status vs error.code occurrences, and show top offending routes.

ops-bot: deploy-notice: New API error fields behind feature flag deployed to staging cluster at 2024-08-12T14:02:00Z.

aj: Thx. I'll schedule a quick sync tomorrow to align SDK owners and Product Docs. Please add items to the API-error epic and tag me. :thumbsup:

maria: Added to epic. I'll draft a standard error message list for Console copy (short + long variants).

devon: PRs opened: runtime change (#4572) and proxy preserve-status (#4573). Requests for reviewers @aj @sasha.

sasha: Reviewed #4573, small comment on header passthrough. Will approve after fix.

aj: Great. If everyone agrees on the mapping I'll add it to API docs and compatibility notes.

maria: Agreed. Quick checklist here: canonical status mapping, machine `error.code`, `retryable`+`retry_after`, streaming error control-frame behavior, console copy sync, telemetry tile, staged rollout plan.

sasha: +1, and log a postmortem if we see customer regressions.

ops-bot: incident-bot: Created task TKT-8421 to track customer regressions related to error code changes.
